blocks.html: Luca Ponzanelli is a Senior R&D Engineer at CodeLounge, a center for software research & development, part of the Software Institute at Università della Svizzera italiana (USI) in Lugano, Switzerland. Luca earned a PhD in Software Engineering in 2017 from Università della Svizzera italiana, and his research interests include mining software repositories, software maintenance, and recommender systems for software engineering. Luca is a passionate Scala developer with several years of experience. He loves using Scala for any type of application, from academic prototypes to scripts for daily life hacks.
